record.dic_text:
0550 'Amnown {am-no:n'} 或 'Amiynown {a-mi:-no:n'}

源自 0539; 陽性專有名詞 人名

欽定本 - Amnon 28; 28

暗嫩 = "有信心的"
1) 大衛王的長子, 強佔了其妹子他瑪 (同父異母), 後為押沙龍所殺
2) 示門 (屬迦勒家族) 的兒子之一 (#代上 4:20|)
record.edic_text:
0550 'Amnown {am-nohn'} or 'Amiynown {am-ee-nohn'}

from 0539;; n m

AV - Amnon 28; 28

Amnon = "faithful"
1) oldest son of David, rapist of Tamar, slain by Absalom
2) a son of Shimon (of Caleb's clan)
